candidates.observedWeakness: Passive garage choices and no recovery decision after cargo damage; short five-route progression. Direct rendered baseline throttle/pause inspected; old campaign route evidence is not new-round completion evidence.

testing: 40 engine + 33 DOM checks passed locally, including all ten kit deliveries and unchanged classic routes. Native browser campaign and screenshots pending.
candidates.remaining: Native keyboard/touch rendered campaigns, screenshots, new kit loss/retry, manual scene review, commit evidence.
